_comment: SSH-mode targets for direct_ssh_client.py. Copy to $HARNESS_HOME/targets.json (chmod 600). Keys starting with _ are ignored. Backend names: lowercase letters, digits, dashes. ssh_key is relative to $HARNESS_HOME or absolute. switch_helper is optional (claude only): a script supporting `<helper> export <model>` that prints shell exports for that model. Optional Ada-only backends tw-tl-codex / tw-tl-claudecode use a dedicated workspace (…/src-tech-leader); do not point ordinary bots at them. Real hosts stay in private $HARNESS_HOME/targets.json only.

tw-tl-codex._comment: Ada tech-leader Codex only; placeholder host/path — copy to private targets.json with real values.

tw-tl-claudecode._comment: Ada tech-leader Claude Code only; same dedicated workspace as tw-tl-codex.
